job.job_description:
We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Backend Development, Generative AI, and Machine Learning to build and scale AI-powered products. The ideal candidate will work on LLM-based applications, AI agents, conversational AI systems, and backend services, ensuring robust, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Develop AI agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and conversational AI systems.
Integrate LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.) into production workflows.
Implement prompt engineering, model evaluation, fine-tuning, and optimization techniques.
Design and manage vector databases and semantic search systems.
Develop and deploy ML/NLP models for classification, prediction, and automation use cases.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
Optimize model performance, latency, and inference costs in production environments.
Build monitoring, logging, and evaluation frameworks for AI applications.
Ensure best practices in software engineering, testing, deployment, and code quality.

Required Skills

36 years of experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Backend Development, or related fields.
Strong programming expertise in Python.
Experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, and Generative AI applications.
Strong understanding of NLP, Transformer architectures, and modern AI frameworks.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
Proficiency in PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, or equivalent ML frameworks.
Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS).
Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment practices.

Preferred Skills

Experience working with Conversational AI, Chatbots, Voice Bots, or Speech Technologies (ASR/TTS).
Exposure to MLOps tools and model deployment pipelines.
Experience in FinTech, Banking, or SaaS product environments.
Knowledge of Agentic AI workflows and multi-agent systems.
